subject: Demo & Throughput Kickoff — Greymatter alignment
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@greymatter.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo & Throughput Kickoff — Greymatter alignment

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a dedicated sizing call and a short demo: 

What we heard on the call
- Primary use case: near-real-time classification + reranking for search results (low-latency okr).
- Expected peak pattern: bursts up to ~300 qps for 30–45s, baseline 30 qps.
- Target 99th latency: <150ms per token for the critical path.

Next steps (asking for two things before we schedule):
1) Can you confirm a couple of target windows (we've got availability Wed/Thu afternoons PT and Fri morning PT)?
2) Please attach a small sample of typical payloads (JSON or CSV) and an approximate tokens-per-request estimate — that will help our sizing run-rate assumptions.

Proposed agenda for the dedicated session (30–45m):
- 5m intro and success criteria
- 10m walk-through of Greymatter workload/profile
- 15–20m dedicated sizing: throughput, batching, KV/cache expectations
- 5–10m actions & rollouts (canary, fallback model variants)

I've attached a short Redwood playbook that outlines what we'll cover and a suggested pre-call checklist. If you prefer a different slot, drop a few times and we'll adjust. Once we lock a time, Ben will run the sizing matrix and Evelyn will bring the demo artifacts.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-playbook.pdf (staged)
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@greymatter.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@greymatter.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo & Throughput Kickoff — Greymatter alignment

Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap and the playbook. Wed or Thu afternoon PT works best for us; Thu 3:00–3:45pm PT would be my preference.

Quick answers to your pre-asks:
- Tokens per request: roughly 150–240 tokens (average ~180) for the classification+rerank flow.
- Sample payloads: attaching a small CSV extract (first 200 rows) that represents the peak workload shape. It includes request_id, prompt_length, and backend_flags.
- Additional note: our models are a mix of an open encoder + small tuned decoder; we expect warm KV hit-rates high after steady state.

I'll confirm the other stakeholders after this thread but Priya and I will be on the call. If Ben and Evelyn can cover the sizing and a 10–15m demo of the routing/fallback policy that'd be great.

Samir Khan
Head of Platform Eng | Greymatter
samir.khan@greymatter.ai

Attachments: greymatter-load-sample.csv (sample, 200 rows)
